findings.claim: The plan admits three blocking constraints are not covered by any change gate and pushes required gate creation to execute instead of incorporating it into the planned work.
findings.evidence: Constraint compliance table marks `references-resolve`, `schemas-parse`, and `no-brand-leakage` as `GAP — new gate required (see below)`, followed by `Execute must add these before the affected change can pass`; project constraints state blocking constraints `prevent archiving until resolved`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit planned tasks/gate IDs to p7-02 and p7-05 before execution begins, with the exact commands from `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md`, so the plan itself covers all blocking constraints.

findings.claim: Two required gate additions are not written as testable acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: The plan specifies `p7-02 — add to Gate: every references/... path cited in prompts/ still resolves` and `p7-02 and p7-05 — add to Gate: no-brand-leakage grep over shipped content returns nothing`, while the constraints packet provides concrete shell checks for both (`grep -roh 'references/...` and `grep -rn 'sediment://' ...`).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the prose gate additions with the exact shell checks from the constraints, including expected exit/output semantics.

findings.claim: The plan omits the `plugin-manifest-current` warning constraint despite planning skill registration work.
findings.evidence: Warning constraints include `plugin-manifest-current` with description `plugin.json updated when new skills or agents were added`; the plan says p7-05 includes `skill registration` and tracks only `hook-scripts-executable` and `no-stub-comments` under warning constraints.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a p7-05 manual-review gate confirming `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and marketplace metadata are current if the scaffold skill or agent registry changes.
